batting.name: SM Katich
batting.dismissal: c Harbhajan Singh b DS Kulkarni

batting.name: Yuvraj Singh
batting.dismissal: c DJ Bravo b JP Duminy

batting.name: WA Mota
batting.dismissal: c Harbhajan Singh b JP Duminy

batting.name: B Lee
batting.dismissal: c RR Raje b SL Malinga

batting.name: ST Jayasuriya
batting.dismissal: c WA Mota b B Lee

balls.text: full and wide, Sreesanth tried to hoick that over mid-off, misses the ball
full on offstump, Sreesanth backed away and dug it out towards mid-off for a single
overpitched well outside off, Goel had walked way across his stumps, so much so that he ended up getting right behind the line of that ball to drive it awkwardly to mid-off
another wide by Malinga, full and down the leg side
banged in by Malinga, Sreesanth goes for the hook, doesn't connect, the ball goes through to the keeper, batsmen take the run anyway
full toss outside leg, Sreesanth was backing away tried to hack it towards midwicket, bottom edged by the batsman
length ball first up, keeps low, Goel squeezes it towards backward point
pushed through flatter and fuller, Sreesanth gets behind the line and defends it cautiously
length ball outside off, Sreesanth gets down on his knee and looks to sweep, misses
this one is on middle and leg, turned towards midwicket
topspinner from Harbhajan, just outside off, a lot of bounce surprises Sreesanth
short ball, turning in towards off, bounced a bit as well, Sreesanth defends studiously off the back foot
low full toss on off, punched towards extra cover
overpitched on middle, Sreesanth edges it away towards midwicket
bouncer outside off, 135kmh, Sreesanth plays inside the line of that one as it whizzes past his helmet grill
Malinga has completely lost his radar here, that was full and a couple of feet down the leg side, third consecutive wide

this is poor from Malinga, short and way down the leg side, the keeper Takawale has a rough day so far, he doesn't collect this one either, Punjab decide to go for the single though the ball sin't too far from Takawale, who throws down the stumps at the striker's end catching Chawla short of the crease, can Punjab play out the 20 overs?
full and down the leg side and he'll have to re-bowl that one
four streaky runs, Chawla was looking to evade a bouncer, left his bat hanging high, and the bouncer flies out the face of the bat over the keeper's head, completely unintentional that

outstanding catch from Rohan Raje, that's the end of Lee, it was back of a length outside off, Lee gets his front foot out of the way and clouts it towards long-off, Raje had to run in and dive to complete that catch, great work from the youngster
short and wide, Lee was moving towards leg and give it an almighty heave, misses the ball
starts with a length ball outside off, hammered back past the bowler, Raje puts in a despairing dive at mid-off but it  beats him and runs away for four
low full toss outside leg, Lee was backing away, he slogs it down to long-on for a single
yorker on offstump, squeezed out to backward point by Goel
on legstump this time, swept by Lee behind square to bring up the 100
full and flat from Jayasuriya, defended back to the bowler
fired into legstump, Lee went for the sweep,  hit on the pads and the ball balloons over the keeper's head, neither batsman nor keeper knew where that went
Jayasuriya starts with a full ball outside off, Goel is down the pitch and plays it inside out towards extra cover

another appeal for lbw as Lee is struck on the pad, he was on the backfoot but was hit in front of leg and the turn would have taken the ball down leg, replays though suggest the ball would have hit legstump
big appeal for lbw, but that pitched outside leg and Goel got some bat on it
Karan Goel gets a much-needed boundary, he was down the track and crunched that down the ground past a diving Harbhajan
turned towards wide mid-off this time
punched to the left of Duminy, goes down to long-off for a single
Duminy continues to be tidy, on a length outside off, defended back to the bowler
full delivery on middle, turned to square leg by Lee
a touch short, just outside off, cut powerfully but straight at the fielder at cover point, just a single
way down the leg side, Lee sweeps it fine for a single, would have been a wide if he let that go

Pomersbach is bowled, done in by the flight, Rahane started with a couple of poor deliveries but this one is on target, it was tossed up and pitched on leg, Pomersbachwas down the pitch looking to whip it towards leg side, misses the ball which hurtle onto middle stump
again wide outside off, cut straight to the cover fielder
given some width, carved towards deep point by Pomersbach
fullish and pitching on off, punched firmly towards long-off for a single
this time Goel connects with the sweep, but there is a fielder at deep square leg
Duminy keeps it full, nicely flighted, on middle stump, batsman goes for the sweep but is hit on the thigh pad
overpitched in the pads, worked away towards deep square leg for a single
outside off this time, played with soft hands towards cover point
tossed up, pitching on middle and turning away, punched to mid-off
Goel glides it behind point for a single to retain the strike
dropped, it was a quick delivery that didn't turn too much, got the outside edge and went low to Tendulkar's right at first slip, but the Mumbai captain couldn't latch on to it
length ball on the pads, turned towards square leg for a single
on the front foot again and driven towards mid-off
comes down the track and pushes it towards mid-on
flighted and some turn for Harbhajan, spins past the frontfoot defence offered by the batsman
length ball just outside off, cautiously played towards point by Pomersbach
turned towards wide mid-on for a single
Punjab in all sorts of trouble, Duminy's dream IPL continues, Yuvraj came down and tried to loft it over leg, gets a thick outside edge which looped to Bravo at point, big wicket that
underedged towards point by Yuvraj
outside off and left alone by Yuvraj

Harbhajan Singh juggles around a bit before taking the catch to dismiss Mota, the batsman was down the track and heaved it high toward long-on, was long enough to clear the rope but was very high, Harbhajan nearly madea meal of it, taking it on the fourth attempt
beautiful from Yuvraj, timing and placement were spot-on, it wasn't too wide outside off, Yuvraj waited on it and guided it behind backward point and infront of  third man
back of a length, angling into the pads, inside-edged onto the pads, the batsmen sprint through for a quick single
Yuvraj stands tall and punches a length delivery to long-off for a single
carved away to deep point for a single by Mota
played to midwicket and that could have been yet another run-out, Tendulkar's throw missed the stumps with Mota well out of his crease after being turned back by yuvraj
starts with a short ball, batsman gets out of the way, Takawale can't collect cleanly giving away free runs
Yuvraj closed the face a touch early on that offstump ball, there wasn't too much power behind his shot so the ball rolls harmlessly along the pitch towards the bowler
punched firmly off the backfoot towards deep extra cover for a single
sharp turn for Harbhajan, Yuvraj rocks back to make room and cuts that past point
pushes up the length a bit, Yuvraj defends it back down the pitch
length ball on offstump, prodded towards cover point by Wilkin Mota

Harbhajan gets a big wicket, tossed up by Harbhajan, Sangakkar was down the pitch and looking to slam that length-ball over the leg side, the ball didn't turn much and he's beaten and the ball crashes into middle stump, Harbhajan sends off the batsman with a playful goodbye wave
length ball, pitching on middle and off, defended off the front foot to the off side by Sangakkara
nicely flighted by Duminy, turns away from Sangakkara, who gets a top edge past backward point
well outside off, poked towards backward point
swept to deep backward square leg for a single
on middle and leg, Yuvraj plays around it and is struck high on the pads
he starts with a length ball outside off, bottom edge wide of the keeper
played with soft hands towards square leg, calls immediately for a single, and the batsmen get through well in time
this time he jumps out of his crease and crunches it down to long-on
another arm ball, Sangakkara can only play it back to the bowler
lovely delivery from Harbhajan, straighter this time, Sangakkara can't get bat on ball again
short and wide, went for the cut but is beaten again by the spin
on a good length outside off, spun away sharply and beats the outside edge as Sangakkara came forward to defend
full and outside off, Yuvraj punches it towards mid-off, straight to the fielder, so there's no run
full toss on the pads, sensational timing from Yuvraj to get off the mark, wristy flick and the placement is perfect as well
more fuller from Raje, yuvraj steps out and drives it inside out towards mid-off, no run again
pushes up the length a bit, a bit wider outside off, Yuvraj opened the face to play it to third man, but is beaten
a touch shorter but the same line, Yuvraj defends with exaggerated care
finds his radar this time, on length angling towards off, defended towards extra cover by Sangakkara
his first ball is down the leg side, the wicketkeeper is standing up and couldn't collect that, so free runs for Punjab
length ball around offstump, cautiously defended back to the bowler by Yuvraj
lovely flick to midwicket this time, the single brings Yuvraj on strike
length ball on the pads, knocked towards midwicket, no run though

a lazy bit of cricket from Sohal, and he is run out, Sangakkara pushed it towards extra cover, where Tendulkar misfielded, Sohal took a few paces down the track and was tardy getting back, Tendulkar's direct hit catching him short
short, slower ball, Sohal triess to guide it past short third man, can't keep it down and it flies towards Jayasuriya who can't hold onto it despite a diving attempt
wow, that was an unbelievable hit from Sohal, almost a half-volley outside off, Sohal bends his knee to get underneath it and slices it over third man for yet another six
a bit shorter this time and on offstump, Sangakkara gets on teh front foot and taps it back to the bowler
Kulkarni keeps it on a length, on middle and leg, watchfully played back to the bowler by Sangakkara
this time the ball is on middle and leg, Sohal nudges it in front of square leg for a single
Slam! Sohal's on fire here, gets his front foot out of the way, and carves that over cover for yet another six
Sohal shows us his resourcefulness, that was slightly overpitched, about a foot outside off, Sonal walls across and scoops it towards fine leg for a boundary
length ball, in the corridor outside off, played with soft hands down the pitch for a single
Bang! Sohal doesn't improve Bravo's mood by slashing a wide ball outside off into the crowd over cover, that was sweetly struck
this time it's a no-ball  for height, this time it's just over Sohal's head
very short from Bravo, 129.9kmh, that sailed way over the batsman's head
on middle and leg this time, worked away to midwicket by Sangakkara, who gets off the mark with that shot
good start by Bravo, it's on a length just outside off, Sangakkara gives the point fielder some work
length ball outside off, watchfully played towards point by new batsman Sangakkara

Irfan's run out, that was a ridiculous bit of cricket, a back of a length ball which Irfan inside-edged onto his thigh pad, rolls away a couple of metres ahead of him to the left, Irfan sets off for a single, the bowler Bravo picks up the ball at the end of his follow through and throws down the stumps
starts with a shortish ball outside off, bottom edge from Irfan, goes on the bounce to the keeper

an audacious stroke attempted by Sohal, he shuffled well outside off to flick a fullish ball to fine leg, the ball was onto him quicker than he expected and it balloons off the bottom the bat behind and to the right of the keeper
this is poor from Malinga, he was well over the bowling crease as he sent down another bouncer outside off, Sohal tried to chip it over the keeper but doesn't connect
wild delivery from Malinga, short and very wide outside off, and high over the batsman's head as well
short outside the offstump this time, Sohal leaves that one alone

sloppy work from the keeper Takawale, it was a shortish ball from Malinga, Sohal had walked across his stumps and innovatively tried to paddle-pull it to fine leg, doesn't connect too well and it goes towards the keeper on the bounce, but Takawale doesn't collect it
there's the length ball, on the pads, Sohal moves across a touch and flicks it wonderfully behind square leg for a boundary, timing was impeccable on that

misunderstanding, Irfan had to scurry back to make his ground, it was full outside off, Sohall shuffles across and punches it towards extra cover, takes a couple of paces down the pitch before deciding against the single
wonder when Malinga will send down a length ball, this one was again in the blockhole, patted back to the bowler by Sohal
Irfan Pathan plays it to midwicket, that was on a length around the offstump
more wrist work on display from Sohal, this was wide outside off and he opens the face to run it to third man
fullish ball on middle and leg, wristy shot towards mid-on, too well hit to get a single
beautiful shot from Sohal, was in the slot outside off, gets on the front foot and coaxes it through the covers, it's a quick outfield and the ball races to the boundary

Katich is gone for a duck, Kulkarni has a knack of striking in the first over in the Ranji Trophy, he does it again here, this was a length ball on middle stump, Katich was looking to work it to leg, closes the face too early and gets an edge which swirls to Harbhajan Singh at mid-off
starts with a length ball on the pads, turned towards midwicket by Katich
slower ball from Malinga to end the over, 117 kmh, half-volley on the pads, Sohal caresses it past square leg for a boundary, wonderful timing
another bouncer, on middle and leg, that was very short and Sohal had plenty of time to see it and duck under
slower ball, 118kmh, doesn't get it on target, down the leg side, and that's the first run for Punjab
another short ball, on middle stump, Sohal fends it towards midwicket, and charges down the track for a single, Katich sends him back
surprises him with the bouncer, just outside off, 142kmh, Sohal sways out of the way
again it is overpitched, this time on middle and leg, Sohal nudges it towards square leg awkwardly
Malinga starts with a traditional full ball, this was pretty wide outside off, Sohal tried to guide it to third man, doesn't connect
finishes in grand style, an authoritative pull sends the ball hurtling to the midwicket boundary, and that seals an emphatic win for Mumbai
slower ball on the pads, worked towards midwicket for a single

Tendulkar tries to finish it off the free-hit, gets an outside edge as he looks to swing over leg, the ball balloons in the air towards point, four fielders get around it, but no one goes for the catch, the umpire Rudi Koertzen has a laugh about that
another yorker from Lee, under-edged by Tendulkar towards short midwicket, Lee had overstepped so that will be a free-hit
it's a very slow bouncer this time, 115kmh, Bravo waits and pulls it towards deep midwicket for a single
great over from Lee so far, the bouncer strikes Bravo on the back of his helmet, 143kmh was too quick for Bravo who took his eye off the ball, Lee asks after the batsman's health after that ball
wide yorker from Lee this time, Bravo just about manages to reach it, all he can do is carve it towards cover point
another bouncer, again 123 kmh, well outside off, Bravo goes for a roundhouse cut but misses, it wide and high enough to be deemed illegal
this time it is a slower bouncer, 123kmh, Bravo was startled by that one, he ducks under well in time though
Lee starts the over with a yorker on middle stump, that was at 141.2kmh, Bravo just abpout managed to get his bat down in time to keep it out
short of a length and wide outside off, Bravo shuffles across and his wristy on-drive sends the ball scurrying towards long-on
overpitched on offstump this time, Tendulkar crunches it down to long-off for an easy single
that kept a bit low, Tendulkar stayed on the backfoot and had to bend his knees and defend to keep that out
slower ball, on a length on middle, Bravo waits for it and turns it to fine leg
swings in a touch after pitching on middle, Tendulkar stayed on the back foot and nudged it towards square leg
nicely length, just outside off, pushed off the front foot towards mid-off
flatter and quicker, Bravo is down the track but can only pat it back to the bowler
driven firmly to long-on for a single
Sreesanth is nutmegged as he tries to field at the square leg boundary, Karan Goel isn't happy with that at all, Mumbai are coasting towards victory here
nothing wrong with the timing in that shot, that is hammered with the spin towards wide long-on
overpitched on offstump, Tendulkar mistimes it back to the bowler
pushed through quicker outside off, Tendulkar looks to guide it to third man, is beaten
flighted outside off, bunts it straight to cover
good appeal this time, googly, turned back in, went forward to defend, it kept a little low to strike him on the pads but just marginally outside the line
shortish, charges down the pitch to turn it away, hit high on the pads as it turns away, appeal, but a ridiculous one
googly bowled from wide of the crease, on the off stump, closes the face and defends it back to the bowler
short of a length outside off, waited for it to turn away and slapped it to deep cover
Sails into the crowd, this is ending quickly now, tossed up on middle, made way, got down on one knee and slog-swept it over wide long-on for a massive six, went off the middle
back of length on middle, whipped away to midwicket
delicately done, tossed up outside off, waited for it, bent low and paddled it fine for three more
much fuller, on middle and off, tickled behind square for a single to bring up the 50-stand
on the off stump, maintaining a shortish length, defended back to the bowler
is lucky, short of a good length outside off, dabs at it hard, gets an inside edge just wide of leg stump to fine leg for a couple
short of a length, turns in, gets on the back foot and swings it to deep backward square-leg
inside-edged towards mid-on, 'Nooooo' bellows Bravo after hitting it to ensure Sachin doesn't set off for the run
overpitched, Bravo glof-swings it beautifully over mid-off for more runs, Lee's mood worsens
another short one, this doesn't bounce too much, Bravo tried to get out of its way, seemed to brush his shoulder on the way through
fuller and wider, Tendulkar punches it towards cover, not very well timed
whoah, Chinese cut (or French cut) for four, that was very close to offstump, Tendulkar was looking for a booming off-drive there
another slower ball, 113kmh, angling into the pads, worked away to square leg
free-hit goes abegging, that was a slower ball, 116kmh, very short and wide, Bravo was through with his shot before the ball was halfway through the pitch
starts with a quick bouncer, had Bravo in a bit of a bother, but Lee undoes the good work by overstepping when delivering
how unlucky can Chawla get? again he gets the outside edge, that delivery got the better of Tendulkar, but again the edge zips between the keeper and first slip for four
Bravo doesn't pick the googly again, Chawla appeals, Koertzen says no as it hit him just outside off
Bravo goes hard at it, gets a thick edge which races wide of the keeper and to the left of short third man
cross-batted swipe from Tendulkar, an ugly shot,  that was full and outside off, gets a thick bottom edge towards midwicket
this time Tendulkar is beaten, he tries a front-foot on-drive but the turn takes it past his bat
flighted and a touch short, Tendulkar caresses it behind point
shuffles across and turns it towards square leg, again he wants two and they get scamper through, that's his fifty, a pretty high percentage of the runs given that Mumbai have made 62
goes for the cut and misses, there was hardly any room for that shot
driven wide of the mid-on fielder, Bravo immediately called for two, and they get it easily
short and wide, Tendulkar slaps it hard off the backfoot, but straight to the man at deep point
calmly turned towards mid-on for a single
Bravo continues to dish out the big hits, Yuvraj tossed it up, Bravo sashays down the pitch and heave it over the bowler's head for six, that went 100 metres
slightly shorter, just outside off, Tendulkar cuts it towards cover point
full and wide, Tendulkar bends his knee and squeezes it towards cover
pushed towards deep cover for a single
that kept lower than Bravo expected, and it was the googly, which Bravo didn't pick, still he adjusts well to carve it behind point
tossed up by Chawla, played inside out towards mid-off by Bravo
pushed off the front foot towards cover
gives it some air again, Bravo looks to defend off the front foot, gets the outer half of the bat
flatter and full in legstump, jabbed towards square leg
a bit of flight from Yuvraj, spins sharply across the face of Tendulkar's bat
pushed down the ground for a single off the front foot
tried to crash it off the backfoot  through covers but can't beat the field
defended off the front foot down the pitch
pitched up, good-looking cover drive from Tendulkar to start off

Rudi Koertzen takes his time before raising his finger in slow motion, Rahane is gone lbw, that was a straighter one from Chawla, Rahane was looking for the turn and played outside the line, is rapped on the pads in front of middle, that's the end of him
quicker through the air, bounces a bit more, Bravo slaps it off the backfoot towards cover point
defended back to the bowler, Rahane was charging down for a single before being sent back
more flair from Bravo, that was tossed up from Chawla, Bravogets his front foot out of the way and wristily sends it scurrying past mid-on
goes for the sweep, edges it onto his pads and onto the pitch
back of a length outside off, Bravo has had enough of the big hits, he just drops it to the off side and zips through for a single
Bravo gets all Caribbean on us, it was on his thigh pad, whipped away to square leg for yet another boundary,  again effortless stroke
and again, this one was a wristy one from Bravo, pitched up on offstump, a flick from Bravo has it scattering the crowds behind long-on, no power behind these shots from Bravo

wow, beautiful shot from Bravo, massive six over the bowler's head, this was a touch fuller, Bravo got onto the front foot, was nowhere near the pitch, but went through with the stroke, a clean hit has it sailing over the sightscreen, Bravo holds the follow-through for the cameras
effortless pull for four, that was pretty short, sat up for Bravo, who swung that over midwicket for a boundary
back of a length ball around offstump, driven on-the-up towards extra cover
yorker outside off, 134 kmh, squeezed towards cover point, and the batsmen sprint through for a single
overpitched on middle and leg, Bravo looks to swat it over long-on, mishit but clears the fielder in the ring
slightly shorter, Rahane gets onto the front foot and drives confidently towards mid-off
lovely delivery from Irfan, inswinging yorker, dug out back to the bowler
back of a length, just outside off, Bravo pushes it towards the off side after getting on the back foot
swung in and hit Bravo on the pads, Irfan goes up in appeal, that pitched on leg but  was going down
short, quick and wide, 142kmh, Rahane swings at it and doesn't connect
another bouncer from Lee, this time it is wider outside off, Rahane drops his wrists and lets that one go
digs in the bouncer, 138 kmh, Bravo goes for the pull, he's doesn't quite get hold of it and it sails towards mid-on on the bounce
this is a lot better from Lee, on a length, in the corridor outside off, Rahane gets across and defends it back down the pitch
attempted slower one, 112kmh, but was way off target, well wide of offstump
beautiful flick from Bravo, back of a length ball on middle stump, Bravo shuffles across and whips it to deep square leg

short and wide, not the greatest of deliveries but it gets him the big wicket of Jayasuriya, the batsman threw his bat at it, it gets a thick top edge and soars towards third man, where Wilkin Mota make good ground to complete the catch
that ends a great over from Irfan, pitching on a length, on middle and off, Bravo gets behind the line and defends with exaggerated caution
goes for a flamboyant off-drive to an overpitched ball, mistimes it towards mid-off
fishes at a slower ball which is angled across him, 114 kmh, it was a touch short as well, Bravo's attempted cut misses and the ball goes through to the keeper after a second bounce
angling across Bravo, who lets it go by lifting his bat high over his head

dropped by Irfan, Bravo was into his shot early, it was a back of a length outside off, Bravo planted his foot forward and looked to swing it over extra cover, the bats turned in his hand and sped back to the bowler, who couldn't hang on
a hint of swing into Bravo, who gets across and nudges it towards square leg
slower short ball, 118kmh, wide outside off, Jayasuriya has to check his shot, gets a bottom edge and the ball dribbles towards cover point
hurtling in towards offstump, Jayasuriya gets on the front foot and defends it back to the bowler
a bit shorter and on the pads, Jayasuriya turns it towards square leg and yells 'Wait' to the non-striker
effortless from Jayasuriya, slightly overpitched outside off, all timing from the batsman as he pushes it through the covers
lovely delivery from Lee, 145 kmh, angling across Jayasuriya, the batsman was trying to push it towards mid-off but the angle took the ball beyond the outside edge
much better from Lee, back of a length cramping up Jaysuriya, who jabs it down the pitch
Jayasuriya outs everything behind a swing at a wide ball outside off first up
